5695:707.10d Some effects copy a spell or ability for each player or object it “could target.” The copies are put onto the stack with those targets in the order of their controller’s choice. If the spell or ability has more than one target, each of its targets must be the same player or object. If that player or object isn’t a legal target for each instance of the word “target,” the copy isn’t created. In the case where a replacement effect causes the copy to target more than one object, the copy’s controller chooses one of them to be the new target. The chosen target must be a legal target for that spell or ability.

1. Activate Aethertorch Renegade's first ability: tap it and pay {E}{E} to deal 1 damage to one of the opponent's Dragonmaster Outcasts. That Outcast is destroyed. (You have 1 energy remaining.)

3. Activate Druid of the Cowl: tap it to add {G} to your mana pool.

5. Because Mirrorwing Dragon is the only object targeted by the spell, Mirrorwing Dragon's ability triggers.
6. Mirrorwing Dragon's triggered ability resolves, creating copies of Press into Service for each other creature you control (Servant of the Conduit, Druid of the Cowl, Aethertorch Renegade, and Zada, Hedron Grinder).
7. As the copies resolve:
   - When the copy targeting Druid of the Cowl resolves, Druid gets a +1/+1 counter and untaps. Tap Druid of the Cowl to add {G} to your mana pool.
   - When the copy targeting Servant of the Conduit resolves, Servant gets a +1/+1 counter and untaps. Leave Servant untapped.
   - When the copy targeting Aethertorch Renegade resolves, Renegade gets a +1/+1 counter and untaps. Leave Renegade untapped for now.
   - When the copy targeting Zada, Hedron Grinder resolves, Zada gets a +1/+1 counter and is untapped.
8. The original Press into Service resolves: put a +1/+1 counter on Mirrorwing Dragon (it becomes a 5/6), untap it, and you gain control of it until end of turn with haste.
9. Tap Aether Hub to add {C}. (You now have {C}{G} in your mana pool.)
10. Cast Highspire Infusion ({1}{G}) targeting Zada, Hedron Grinder.
11. Zada's ability triggers, copying Highspire Infusion for each other creature you control (Mirrorwing Dragon, Aethertorch Renegade, Servant of the Conduit, and Druid of the Cowl).
12. All 4 copies and the original Highspire Infusion resolve: each creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn, and each resolution grants you {E}{E} (giving you 10 energy total).
13. Activate Aethertorch Renegade's first ability: tap it and pay {E}{E} to deal 1 damage to the opponent's remaining Dragonmaster Outcast. That Outcast is destroyed. Opponent now controls only the 5/5 Dragon token.
14. Enter combat and declare Mirrorwing Dragon (8/9 flying), Zada, Hedron Grinder (7/7), and Servant of the Conduit (6/6) as attackers.
15. Opponent controls only one creature (the 5/5 Dragon token) and can block at most one attacker:
    - If the Dragon token blocks Mirrorwing Dragon, Zada (7) and Servant of the Conduit (6) deal 13 unblocked damage.
    - If the Dragon token blocks Zada, Mirrorwing Dragon (8) and Servant of the Conduit (6) deal 14 unblocked damage.
    - If the Dragon token blocks Servant of the Conduit, Mirrorwing Dragon (8) and Zada (7) deal 15 unblocked damage.
    - If the Dragon token does not block, all three deal 21 damage.

In every blocking scenario, you deal at least 13 damage to the opponent, winning the game.
</solution>
